name: PseudoSeparable Cross Bilateral Filter
definition: A separable bilateral filter applied to ambient occlusion data, using precomputed depth (TraceDistance) and normal information to weight neighbors, implemented as two passes (horizontal and vertical) to reduce computational cost.
summary: The PseudoSeparable Cross Bilateral Filter is a two-pass screen-space technique that smooths ambient occlusion while preserving edges, distinguished by its reduced computational cost via separability.
